# URL to App

> URL to App is a browser-only, local-first tool that packages an HTTPS website as a small Android WebView APK, an unsigned Windows installer or portable app, or a Linux Flatpak, AppImage or tarball. No account, no cloud build, and no server-side compilation.

URL to App started as an Android WebView packager and later added Windows and Linux targets. It uses a prebuilt shell for each target and patches the URL, app name and icon in the browser tab. Android builds are signed with a non-exportable local key. Generated desktop shells are unsigned and do not auto-update; the Flatpak gets WebKitGTK updates from its shared GNOME runtime. macOS is not supported yet.

## Start

- [Open the builder](https://url2app.yasogan.dev/): Paste an HTTPS URL, choose Android, Windows or Linux, and generate the package locally.
- [Markdown version of the page](https://url2app.yasogan.dev/index.md): The same landing-page facts in plain Markdown for agents.
- [Source code](https://github.com/YasogaN/url2app): Apache-2.0 Kotlin, Rust/Tauri, TypeScript and Cloudflare Workers source.
- [README and architecture](https://github.com/YasogaN/url2app#readme): How the prebuilt shells, browser patching and signing work.

## What it does

- [What you get](https://github.com/YasogaN/url2app#what-you-get): Android launcher icon and APK, Windows Setup.exe or portable zip, and Linux Flatpak, AppImage or tar.gz.
- [How it works](https://github.com/YasogaN/url2app#how-it-works): Prebuilt shells, data-not-compilation patching, local signing, and CI-built bases.
- [Limits](https://github.com/YasogaN/url2app#what-it-is-not): No Google sign-in, push, extensions, App Links, offline copy, macOS, or generated-shell auto-updates. The Flatpak runtime still updates WebKitGTK.
- [Comparison and FAQ](https://url2app.yasogan.dev/#faq): How it differs from PWABuilder, Bubblewrap, Tauri CLI and Electron Forge.
- [Privacy](https://github.com/YasogaN/url2app#privacy): No accounts, analytics or telemetry. The only third-party request is the optional favicon lookup.

## Guides

- [Website to Android APK without a cloud build](https://url2app.yasogan.dev/website-to-apk): Local WebView APK packaging, install steps and limits.
- [Website to Windows or Linux desktop app](https://url2app.yasogan.dev/website-to-desktop-app): Prebuilt Tauri shells, Setup.exe, Flatpak, AppImage and tarball outputs.
- [URL to App vs PWABuilder and Bubblewrap](https://url2app.yasogan.dev/pwabuilder-alternative): When a Trusted Web Activity is the better choice and when a local WebView wrapper is.
- [How local APK signing works](https://url2app.yasogan.dev/apk-signing): WebCrypto key generation, the encrypted .p1x backup and APK Signature Scheme v2.

## Machine-readable

- [AI catalog](https://url2app.yasogan.dev/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): ARD manifest for the builder.
- [Sitemap](https://url2app.yasogan.dev/sitemap.xml): Canonical site URLs.
- [Robots](https://url2app.yasogan.dev/robots.txt): Crawler rules.
